summary: Deprecate namespace fields on cross-namespace workflow command options in the Go SDK following API deprecation in response to Temporal Server 1.30.1 disabling cross-namespace operations by default.
userImpact: Users using cross-namespace operations must update their code as these fields are now deprecated and will be removed in a future version.
proposedFix: Mark ChildWorkflowOptions.Namespace and namespace fields on external cancel/signal options as deprecated, adding doc comment: '// Deprecated: Cross-namespace operations are disabled by default as of server 1.30.1.'
keyQuote: Cross-namespace operations are disabled by default as of server 1.30.1.
